text:
Nina: quick design review  condensed connectivity step for the Private wizard. figma: /designs/onprem/connectivity-condensed-v4. can we get UX + a11y reads before handoff?
Omar: main ask: keep non-technical users on the plain-language path first. show a clear one-line reason: 'We check outbound access so model downloads and health reporting work.'
Casey: add two actions: `Quick check (<20s)` and `Detailed trace (2-3 min)`. show time estimates in parentheses.
Nina: copy draft: 'Checking outbound access to Redwood (this won't change your network).' failure hint: 'If blocked: try opening outbound port 443 or contact your network admin.'
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) status pill must include text and icon; 2) announce status changes via role="status" + aria-live="polite"; 3) ensure error contrast >= 4.5:1.
Omar: privacy question: when user taps 'Share anonymized diagnostics' what do we include? recommend: summarized hop counts + error codes by default; full IP lists only if user explicitly opts in. show a sample redacted payload in the modal.
Infra-bot: probe 1805551250 result=BLOCKED target=api.redwood:443 probe=tcp timeout_ms=4000 hops=4
Casey: show summary first: 'Result: Blocked  port 443 unreachable' then collapsed 'Technical details' with monospace output and a Copy button. collapse by default.
Nina: UX microcopy for consent modal: 'Share anonymized diagnostics with Redwood Support (no credentials included). Click Confirm to include hashed hostnames and summarized hops.' include a link to privacy page.
a11y-bot: extra: ensure the consent modal traps focus and that the confirm button has descriptive text e.g., 'Confirm: share anonymized diagnostics'.
Omar: interaction note: for Quick check show an inline progress with states: 'probing  analyzing  done' and a small toast 'Quick check usually completes in <20s'.
Casey: mobile: stack actions vertically; make Copy button full width.
Nina: acceptance criteria for eng: 1) quick vs detailed probe endpoints; 2) plain-language summary with collapsed technical details + copy; 3) consent modal with redaction options and sample payload; 4) aria-live status region and focus management; 5) default telemetry summarized-only.
Omar: i'll update figma and add the sample redacted snippet.
Casey: i'll add comments about the monospace block and copy affordance.
Nina: thanks team  planning dev handoff tomorrow. tagging @omar for final copy polish. :white_check_mark:
